Message:
Data	is	one	of	the	most	valuable	resources	in	the	modern	world.	Every	organization,	whether	it	is	a	college,	
hospital,	bank,	government	office,	or	online	shopping	platform,	generates	and	stores	large	amounts	of	data	every	
day.	This	data	may	contain	information	about	students,	patients,	customers,	employees,	products,	transactions,	and	
many	other	entities.	
Consider	a	college.	During	an	academic	year,	the	college	stores	information	such	as	student	admission	details,	
attendance	records,	examination	marks,	fee	payments,	faculty	information,	and	course	details.	Similarly,	a	bank	
stores	customer	account	information,	transaction	histories,	loan	records,	and	ATM	operations.	Managing	such	huge	
volumes	of	data	manually	is	extremely	difficult	and	error-prone.
